name: Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH
summary: Drehteile Fuchsreiter is a small founder-owned turned-parts shop (18 staff, turnover 0-2 M EUR, equity 19.6 %). It is advertising free machine capacity, has its second shift on hold and has paused hiring. It calls Hollerau an important reference customer and now asks for faster payment against a cash discount, because we pay late 90 % of the time.

situation.decision_maker: Founder-owner (managing director) decides price. The sales contact runs the talks and passes bigger moves to the owner.

negotiation_pattern: It opens with modest asks, often already a price decrease (-0.8 %, -3.9 %). On renewals it settles about 1.3 points below its ask: -2.1 %, 0.0 % and -5.2 %, a mean of -2.43 %. It has never forced an increase through. Under pressure it concedes on price. Its one sign of pushback is about payment: on our overdue invoices it threatened to 'review our conditions'. Its quote for the coupling hub rose from 17.30 to 17.87 EUR, never awarded.
wants: additional volume / new parts to fill idle capacity (second shift on hold)
punctual payment, ideally within 10 days (willing to pay a cash discount)
keeping Hollerau as a reference customer and a longer, secure framework
forecast security to plan a restart of the second shift
protects: payment terms: will not accept longer than 30 days, and resents our late payment
price on unawarded parts without a volume award in return (coupling hub quote went up, not down)

trades.give: volume_per_year up: award part:320060 (coupling hub, qualified, quota 0 %) and/or raise the part:320090 quota above 50 %
trades.get: unit_price on part:320060 at or below the 2025 quote of 17.30 EUR instead of 17.87, plus a further cut on part:320090 from 4.64
trades.why: Idle machines and a paused shift make volume worth more to them than margin.

trades.get: skonto at a rate well above our cost of money, plus a price hold for 2027
trades.why: They proposed this themselves. Fast cash matters to a low-equity shop that we currently pay about 10 days late.

trades.give: contract_months: extend the framework beyond 2027-06-30 and share a rolling forecast
trades.get: 2027 prices fixed at a reduction, with no index clause
trades.why: Contract length and forecast security let them plan staffing. History shows they give price for it.

trades.give: volume_per_year up (extra parts at short notice)
trades.get: lead_time_days below 28 and a written OTD commitment back to ≥95 %
trades.why: Spare capacity should make shorter lead times cheap for them. OTD has slipped below the contract target.

arguments.point: We can fill part of your free capacity right away: the coupling hub is already qualified with you and the tooling is ours.
We will fix our payment discipline and pay within 10 days, if the skonto and the 2027 price reflect it.
You value us as a reference customer. A longer framework with more parts strengthens that.
OTD fell to 88 % against the 95 % target. More volume requires a delivery commitment.
Past renewals settled at -2.1 % and -5.2 %. A further reduction is consistent with our history together.

avoid: Pushing price hard while ignoring the overdue invoices. That validates their 'review our conditions' threat.
Asking for longer payment terms or any delay in payment.
Threatening to move part:320090 to the other source without offering volume. The founder will feel disrespected.
Promising volume that we do not then order.
tone: Personal and respectful, owner to partner. Acknowledge our late payments first, then offer concrete volume and fast payment in exchange for price.
red_flags: OTD is deteriorating: 95.8 → 92.3 → 88.0 %, now below the 95 % contract target.
Thin equity (19.6 %), payment chasing and the skonto request signal liquidity strain. The credit index is stable at 228, so this is not yet weak.
They threatened to review conditions over our late payments, which carries a walk-away or price-increase risk.
Restarting the paused second shift for extra volume may cause a ramp-up delay.
Under clause 3.1 the supplier's notice deadline for 2027 price changes falls around 2026-10-02. Watch for a late increase notice.

evidence.claim: Free machine capacity is advertised, hiring is paused and the second shift is on hold since spring.
Hollerau is an important reference customer for them.
They complained about overdue invoices and then asked for 10-day payment against a cash discount. We pay late 90 % of the time, about 10 days on average, and take no skonto.
Current price for the spacer sleeve is 4.64 EUR (renewal settled -2.1 %). The coupling hub quote rose from 17.30 to 17.87 EUR and was not awarded.
Hollerau owns the tooling and has one other source for each part, so our dependency is low.
Quality is fine: ppm is 318 and improving, with no overdue 8D. OTD is slipping.
The framework runs to 2027-06-30 with auto-extension, prices fixed per calendar year, and a 90-day notice for price changes.

indicators.credit_index: 228 (12 months ago 228; higher is worse, >300 weak)
indicators.scorecard_trend: 2025Q4 green (otd 95.8, ppm 409) → 2026Q1 green (otd 95.8, ppm 496) → 2026Q2 green (otd 92.3, ppm 374) → 2026Q3 green (otd 88.0, ppm 318)
